items.question: Does the Federal Decree-Law No. 31 of 2025 on Higher Education and Scientific Research apply to higher education institutions located in free zones?
items.gold: Yes, its provisions apply to all HEIs and TVET institutions across the UAE, including those in free zones.
items.fact: Federal Decree-Law 31/2025 covers institutions in UAE free zones

items.question: What is the number of the Ministerial Resolution concerning admission standards for higher education institutions' programmes in the UAE?
items.fact: Admission standards set by Ministerial Resolution No. 19 of 2024
